title: Vercel media placeholder
description: Plain token-coloured stand-ins for media: a ringed pale-grey window that fades into the page at its bottom (screenshots), a soft grey haze (hero art), a light-to-bright blue wash (small artwork) or a grey panel fading out towards one side (art beside text). Nothing is drawn.
notes: fills the box it is given; size and position come from the parent or className
pass children to put real media inside the window frame
name: vercel-placeholder

props.name: tone
props.description:
window: ringed grey frame fading out at the bottom · haze: soft grey glow in the middle ·
wash: light-to-bright blue · side: grey panel fading out to the left

props.name: label
props.description: what the slot will hold, read to screen readers (e.g. "Product screenshot")

props.name: children
props.description: real media to show inside the frame instead of the empty surface
